searchText: Who controls access to the discord group affiliations? what is the update process and protocol? I think it needs to be a mod that updates the role. Typically to add someone we'd want confirmation from someone already on the team. Removing a role would be either by request of the person its removing it from or from one of the team leads informing us they no longer work there or whatever. Can the Ipsilon group be sorted below the EF group then, since it no longer implies EF employment? Also, the EF layoffs are not reflected in current group membership. Changed the ordering (cc <@&595685821026271242> please yell if I shouldn't have). Will follow up with EF folks about reflecting the EF layoffs.
